nodes.name: Claude Analysis
nodes.notes: Structured outputs guarantee the reply matches the rubric schema, so no JSON repair is needed downstream. Timeout is 5 minutes because scoring a long transcript with thinking enabled is not fast.

assignments.name: ai
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { if ($json.stop_reason === 'refusal') { throw new Error('Claude declined to score this call. stop_reason: refusal.'); } const block = ($json.content ?? []).find(b => b.type === 'text'); if (!block) { throw new Error('No text block in the Claude response. stop_reason: ' + $json.stop_reason); } return JSON.parse(block.text); })() }}

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: Finds the text block by type rather than taking content[0] — with thinking enabled the first block is a thinking block.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const ai = $json.ai; const d = $('Extract Direct Fields').item.json; const S = ai.scores; const DIMS = [['frame_ownership','Frame Ownership'],['discovery_depth','Discovery Depth'],['belief_architecture','Belief Architecture'],['pitch_precision','Pitch Precision'],['tension_management','Tension Management'],['objection_resolution','Objection Resolution'],['qualification','Qualification'],['strategic_awareness','Strategic Awareness']]; const overall = Math.round((DIMS.reduce((t, k) => t + S[k[0]].score, 0) / DIMS.length) * 10) / 10; const verdict = overall >= 8.5 ? 'Elite execution' : overall >= 7 ? 'Strong call' : overall >= 5.5 ? 'Average' : 'Fundamentals need work'; const txt = (s) => [{ text: { content: String(s ?? '').slice(0, 1900) } }]; const blk = (type, s) => ({ object: 'block', type: type, [type]: { rich_text: txt(s) } }); const num = (v) => ({ number: (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? null : Number(v) }); const sel = (v) => v ? { select: { name: String(v) } } : { select: null }; const rt = (v) => ({ rich_text: v ? txt(v) : [] }); const yn = (v) => v ? 'yes' : 'no'; const children = [blk('heading_2', 'Scorecard: ' + overall + '/10 — ' + verdict)].concat(DIMS.flatMap(k => [blk('heading_3', k[1] + ' — ' + S[k[0]].score + '/10'), blk('paragraph', S[k[0]].reasoning)])).concat([{ object: 'block', type: 'divider', divider: {} }, blk('heading_2', 'The moment'), blk('paragraph', ai.narrative.the_moment), blk('heading_2', 'Next call drill'), blk('paragraph', ai.narrative.next_call_drill), blk('heading_2', 'Flags'), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Best moment: ' + ai.narrative.best_moment), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Biggest miss: ' + ai.narrative.biggest_miss), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Weakest belief: ' + ai.flags.weakest_belief), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Value leak: ' + yn(ai.flags.value_leak)), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Follow-up trap: ' + yn(ai.flags.follow_up_trap)), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Early price drop: ' + yn(ai.flags.price_drop_too_early))]); const props = { 'Name': { title: txt(d.prospect_name || 'Unknown') }, 'Closer': sel(d.closer), 'Call Date': { date: { start: d.call_date } }, 'Outcome': sel(ai.outcome || 'No deal'), 'Tier': ai.tier ? { select: { name: 'Tier ' + ai.tier } } : { select: null }, 'Price Discussed': num(ai.price_discussed), 'Price Closed': num(ai.price_closed), 'Cash Collected': num(ai.cash_collected), 'Payment Structure': sel(ai.payment_structure), 'Prospect Revenue': rt(ai.prospect_revenue), 'Niche': rt(ai.niche), 'Location': rt(ai.location), 'Lead Source': sel(ai.lead_source === 'ManyChat' ? 'IG' : ai.lead_source), 'Quality Score': num(overall), 'Value Leak': { checkbox: !!ai.flags.value_leak }, 'Follow-Up Trap': { checkbox: !!ai.flags.follow_up_trap }, 'Early Price Drop': { checkbox: !!ai.flags.price_drop_too_early }, 'Weakest Belief': sel(ai.flags.weakest_belief), 'The Moment': rt(ai.narrative.the_moment), 'Next Call Drill': rt(ai.narrative.next_call_drill), 'Duration (min)': num(d.duration_minutes), 'Recording URL': { url: d.share_url || null }, 'Summary': rt(ai.summary) }; DIMS.forEach(k => { props[k[1]] = num(S[k[0]].score); }); return JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_NOTION_DATABASE_ID' }, properties: props, children: children }); })() }}

nodes.name: Write to Notion
nodes.notes: Writes the eight dimension scores as columns and the full written breakdown as the page body. 'Quality Score' holds the overall average.
